command:
set -eu
sudo -n tee /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-loop-start >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
BACKING=/var/lib/srv-data-pv.img
LOOPDEV=$(/sbin/losetup -j "$BACKING" | /usr/bin/awk -F: 'NR == 1 { print $1 }')
if [ -z "$LOOPDEV" ]; then
  LOOPDEV=$(/sbin/losetup --find --show "$BACKING")
fi
/sbin/pvscan --cache "$LOOPDEV"
/sbin/vgchange -ay srv_vg
/bin/udevadm settle
[ -b /dev/mapper/srv_vg-data_lv ]
ANTRIEB_SCRIPT
sudo -n chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-loop-start
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/srv-data-loop.service >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_SERVICE'
[Unit]
Description=Attach persistent loop device for srv_data LVM
DefaultDependencies=no
After=systemd-remount-fs.service systemd-udev-settle.service
Before=local-fs.target srv-data.mount

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/srv-data-loop-start
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs.target
ANTRIEB_SERVICE
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/srv-data.mount >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_MOUNT'
[Unit]
Description=Persistent data logical volume
Requires=srv-data-loop.service
After=srv-data-loop.service
Before=local-fs.target

[Mount]
What=/dev/mapper/srv_vg-data_lv
Where=/srv/data
Type=ext4
Options=defaults

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs.target
ANTRIEB_MOUNT
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable srv-data-loop.service srv-data.mount
sudo -n systemctl start srv-data-loop.service srv-data.mount
systemctl is-enabled srv-data-loop.service srv-data.mount
systemctl is-active srv-data-loop.service srv-data.mount
findmnt /srv/data
